<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="מנחם אב_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919939_theRebbe_869" batchId="meluket-_D7_9E_D7_A0_D7_97_D7_9D_20_D7_90_D7_91_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919939_theRebbe_869__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through Israel fulfilling God's request to reveal the level of Mah of the soul in two ways, God fulfills Israel's request for dwelling in His house and grants each a good and sweet year.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And through the fact that Israel fulfill the request of the Holy One, blessed be He, to reveal the Mah of the soul in the two aforementioned manners — the revelation of the Mah itself as it is above form,</t>
    <t s="1">and its revelation as it is drawn into actuality in the particular levels of the soul</t>
    <t s="2">(Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah, Chayah, Yechidah)</t>
    <t s="3">— through this the Holy One, blessed be He, will fulfill the request of Israel,</t>
    <t s="4">both the general and essential request, "One thing I have asked"45</t>
    <t s="5">as it is in itself — "that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life,"</t>
    <t s="6">and also as it is drawn into many particulars</t>
    <t s="7">("to behold the pleasantness of the Lord and to visit His Temple," etc.),</t>
    <t s="8">and the Holy One, blessed be He, gives each and every one of Israel a good writing and sealing46</t>
    <t s="9">for a good and sweet year in materiality and spirituality, below ten handbreadths.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
